Number of studies.evidence_source: "To determine the confounding variables in the relationship between sexual orientation and body appreciation among bisexual and other sexual minority women, we ran ANOVA and chi-square analyses." (This section describes a single analysis/comparison rather than multiple labeled studies.)

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports bivariate analyses (ANOVA, chi-square) and an ANCOVA comparing Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) scores between bisexual and other sexual minority women, finding no significant differences in BAS after controlling for sexual relationship status (adjusted M_bisexual = 3.73 vs adjusted M_other = 3.69; F(1, 265) = 0.305, p = .581). Sample sizes are inconsistently reported across tests (e.g., N = 265 and N = 266; BMI analysis reports F(1, 225) with N not stated). The section does not label any studies as 'Study 1' or similar and does not provide country, survey method, demographic percentages, mean age, mean BMI, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: "There were no significant differences between bisexual and other sexual minority participants by age, F(1, 263) = 1.20, p = .274, \eta^2 = .016; BMI, F(1, 225) = 0.109, p = .742 \eta^2 = .017; or education, \chi^2(1, N = 265) = .20, p = .655, \phi = .027."; "Bisexual and other sexual minority participants significantly differed by sexual relationship status, \chi^2(1, N = 266) = 94.77, p < .001, \phi = .597..."; "Results indicated there were no significant differences in BAS score for bisexual and other sexual minority women while holding sexual relationship status constant, F(1, 265) = 0.305, p = .581, partial \eta^2 = .001. Thus, bisexual women (adjusted M = 3.73) did not differ significantly in body appreciation from other sexual minority women (adjusted M = 3.69)."
section_summary.warning: Inconsistent sample size reporting across tests (N = 265 vs N = 266); BMI analysis reports F with df indicating reduced sample for that variable but N not explicitly provided.
